name.description: Parent-facing name of the reusable template, not a finished task or passage title.

instanceParameters.description: Useful choices the parent can change each time; do not put generated learning content here.

required.description: True rejects omission when no default exists and rejects blank text. Defaults apply to omitted values regardless of this flag.

default.description: Default matching the field type, bounds and options; null means no default. Preserve supplied source text.

min.description: Inclusive integer lower bound; null when unbounded or not an integer field.

max.description: Inclusive integer upper bound; null when unbounded or not an integer field.

maxLength.description: Text length limit; null uses 500 for text fields and is unused for other types.

options.description: Distinct, trimmed, single-line select values; null for other field types.

instructions.description: Reusable teaching instructions for the task generator: audience, language for each part, fixed requirements and how exact parameter keys affect the task. Do not generate the task here.

questionCountParameter.description: Exact key of the integer parameter controlling question count, bounded within 1-20. It must have required=true or a valid non-null default so its value always resolves. Null for a fixed count.

contentWordCount.description: Fixed total word limits for text bodies in space-delimited languages, across all contentBlocks. Exclude the task title, learner directions, questions and choices. Copy explicitly requested total limits into numeric bounds; otherwise set this whole field to null. Bounds are inclusive; min must not exceed max; equal bounds mean an exact count. Never infer limits from age or difficulty. Variable or per-passage limits stay in instructions.
